name: Medusa
author: Erin Carter
description: Sea-nettle jellyfish drift down through deep water at staggered depths — each a translucent domed bell marked with radial stripes and a dark scalloped margin, trailing a frilly ruffled column of oral arms and a long curtain of fine tentacles that sway on a slow continuous current. No contraction pulse: the jellies simply sink and trail, looping with no visible reset.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: Speed of the slow sink, horizontal sway and tentacle flow.

params.label: Bell size
params.effect: Bell radius in CSS pixels; the oral arms and tentacle length scale with it.

params.label: Jellyfish
params.effect: How many jellyfish drift the frame at once, at staggered depths.

params.label: Brightness
params.effect: Overall emission of the bells, arms and tentacles.

params.label: Tentacle sway
params.effect: How far the tentacles and oral arms drift and curl in the current.

params.label: Atmosphere
params.effect: Drifting colored water-glow and god-ray banding so the frame never reads as dead black.

params.label: Colour spread
params.effect: How far the jelly hues range across the palette; 0 is a single tint, 1 spreads the full set.

params.label: Colour vividness
params.effect: Vividness of the jelly colours; 0 is greyscale, 1 is the raw palette, higher pushes saturation.

params.label: Bell stripes
params.effect: Number of radial stripes marking each translucent bell.

params.label: Tentacle density
params.effect: How many tentacle ribbons hang in each jelly's trailing curtain.
